card.title: Same Old Routine
card.instruction: Use familiar shorthand and old habits immediately, as though past routines still govern the present.

records.mechanism: A immediately applies shared shorthand and established habits to present arrangements, even when those arrangements have changed.
records.distinguishingEvidence: A1 divides the mugs through familiar shorthand; the revision's A3 and A5 preserve their customary sides and shared putting-away routine without demanding indispensability.

card.title: One More Favor

card.title: Don’t Be Difficult
card.instruction: Treat every request, correction, or small inconvenience as a warning that you are becoming too much trouble.

records.mechanism: A treats even a welcomed request as evidence of being burdensome and keeps reducing the space, effort or accommodation A permits themself.
records.confusableConcept: A practical preference for a different utensil.
records.distinguishingEvidence: A3 apologizes for making B stand, and A5 sacrifices finishing the peas despite B4 explicitly removing the extra-trip concern.

card.title: I Packed for You
card.instruction: Take care of practical needs before anyone asks, then resist choices that make your preparation unnecessary.

records.mechanism: A anticipates practical needs without being asked and then defends the use of that preparation when the recipient chooses differently.
records.confusableConcept: Overriding choices for the recipient's own good.
records.distinguishingEvidence: A3 defends the researched cheese rather than claiming sushi is harmful, and A5 insists the work was tailored to B.

card.title: I Packed for You
